description: Port Hope Watch: NASA from space, phone on the ground. Loud inside, quiet outside = contained. Using a phone magnetometer and one formula  — Δ = (Reading − 56) × 1000 — to track trends at Port Hope: Toronto 53.5 clean, Wesleyville 54.1 clean,  Vault 60.9 loud (4900 nT).  No lab. No $10,000 sensor.  Just a phone, one formula, 3 minutes.
